regime: Trend-Down (Indices and Gold Roll Over, Crude Leads)
summary: Risk came off the indices to start the week. NQ broke the opening range down and closed 30,877.5 down 0.79 percent, still below a falling ATR stop. MES lost its trend-long at the cash open and closed 7,857, flat but off the highs, while December gold reversed Friday's run and closed 4,195.9 down 0.58 percent. Crude bucked the tape, up 1.65 percent to 93.18 above a rising stop. VIX ticked up to 15.21 but stayed low, so this reads as an orderly rotation lower in the indices, not a panic.

risk.openRisk: Index trend-long is off, the clean trend-long is crude.
risk.note: The regime flipped to risk-off in the indices. NQ is below a falling stop, MES lost its long stop at the open and gold lost its stop overnight, so systematic trend-long is off on all three and stays off until a two-hourly-close reclaim (MNQ 31,042, MES 7,874, gold 4,218). Crude is the one clean trend-long, above a rising 92.10 stop. VIX is up a touch at 15.21 but still low and ranges are contained, so size stays normal. The move through the Friday lows is real trend, not a one-off, so keep the short-side index read on the board until a stop reclaims. Tuesday is a normal full session with the bond market reopening; thinner holiday carryover and an uncertain federal data calendar argue for patience over size. Next policy event is the FOMC meeting Oct 27 to 28.

psychology: Friday the opening-range break down failed and snapped right back inside. Today it broke down and stayed down. Same setup, opposite result, and that is the whole point. You cannot know in the first five minutes which one you have. The tell is acceptance: today NQ closed hourly bar after hourly bar below the range and below the session VWAP, so sellers kept control. When price breaks a level and then holds beyond it on a closing basis, that is your green light. When it snaps right back inside like Friday, stand down. Trade the confirmation and size up only after the market proves the move, and you stop getting chopped in the first hour.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN (MNQ)
fullReport.html:
OR High 31,049 | OR Low 30,936.25 | Width 112.75 pts (0.36%)

Break DOWN at 14:05 UTC at 30,880.5, and the break held: price closed the session below the range at 30,883.75 and below NYVWAP, a genuine downside continuation. NYVWAP 30,905.48 (closed below). HOF VWAP 30,898.48 (stayed below into the close).

It is Monday, so BIR is skipped. HOF, MID and BNC were eligible. The OR broke down and handed off lower, a clean HOF short structure, and the break stayed below the session VWAPs all afternoon.

A down-break that holds below the opening range and the session VWAP is the real move, the opposite of Friday's failed breakdown. The read is the structure and the acceptance, since volume is disclaimed on the continuous contract.
